summary: Verified Facturen 'Genereer maand' bug + UX fix. Backend endpoint POST /api/invoices/generate-month works (200 with {created,skipped,credit_applied}, 401 no-auth, 400 invalid period, idempotent on 2nd call). Frontend header now has title (h1 text-3xl / 30px) + subtitle on left and BOTH buttons (Genereer maand outline, Nieuwe factuur solid) on right of same row on desktop (1920x900). Click Genereer maand -> confirm -> XHR 200, NO 'Method Not Allowed'. Nieuwe factuur opens creation modal. Mobile view unchanged. Sub-tabs (Alle/Achterstand/Betaald) still work, KPI cards still render.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has a DEAD/duplicate function `generate_month_invoices(body: GenerateMonthIn, ...)` at line 9225 with NO @api.post decorator, and a second `generate_month_invoices(body: dict, ...)` at line 9385 which is the actual route. The first one references model `GenerateMonthIn` and is unreachable dead code — recommend deleting lines 9224-9232 (or wiring properly with a decorator). Both share the same function name which is confusing and only works because Python keeps the last definition.
The active endpoint at line 9385 accepts `body: dict` instead of using the existing Pydantic model `GenerateMonthIn` — inconsistent with rest of codebase and skips schema-level validation.
seed_data_creation: None (endpoint is idempotent; ran against existing seeded huurders)
